UserScore.title: UserScore
UserScore.description: A private MusicXML piano score uploaded or customized by an authenticated user.

id.description: Unique score identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the score owner.

title.description: Display title of the piano piece.

measures.description: Total number of measures in the MusicXML score (1 to 1000).

bpm.description: Default practice tempo in beats per minute (30 to 240).

musicXml.description: Raw MusicXML 3.1 document content (bounded under Firestore 1MB document limit).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was last modified.

UserHotkeys.title: UserHotkeys
UserHotkeys.description: Per-user custom MIDI chord and computer keyboard hotkey bindings.

ownerId.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

restartMidiNotes.description: 1 to 4 MIDI note numbers (21..108) pressed simultaneously to trigger Restart.

stopMidiNotes.description: 1 to 4 MIDI note numbers (21..108) pressed simultaneously to trigger Stop / Wait Mode.

restartKey.description: Computer keyboard key name (e.g. 'r', 'F1') for Restart.

stopKey.description: Computer keyboard key name (e.g. 'Escape', 'Backspace') for Stop / Wait Mode.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when custom hotkeys were created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when custom hotkeys were last updated.

PracticeStatDoc.title: PracticeStatDoc
PracticeStatDoc.description: Aggregated per-bar practice statistics for a user, sheet music piece, practice mode, and tempo.

id.description: Deterministic stat document ID matching the Firestore document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

scoreId.description: Score identifier for which these statistics were recorded.

bpm.description: Selected tempo in BPM (0 for wait mode, 30..240 for tempo mode).

totalRuns.description: Total completed practice passes recorded for this mode/tempo (0..100000).

bars.description: Map of 1-indexed measure numbers (up to 1000 entries) to per-bar practice counts and grade breakdowns.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this statistics bucket was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this statistics bucket was last updated.

/scores/{scoreId}.description: Private user-uploaded and edited MusicXML scores strictly readable and writable only by ownerId == request.auth.uid.

/userSettings/{userId}.description: Private per-user custom hotkey preferences strictly readable and writable only by userId == request.auth.uid.

/practiceStats/{statId}.description: Private per-user per-bar practice statistics grouped by scoreId, mode, and BPM, strictly readable and writable only by ownerId == request.auth.uid.
